study type: cross-sectional, descriptive, observational, and prospective study
cohort: 779 mothers who experienced skin-to-skin contact at birth
finding: The majority of mothers found placing the newborn on their breast after birth to be a happy and satisfying experience.
mod_finding: There was no statistically significant difference in maternal satisfaction with skin-to-skin contact at birth between mothers who delivered vaginally and mothers who delivered by caesarean.
